body:
Every result path borrows an `int[]` from the process-wide `PathSegmentPool`, and every rent and return takes its `SpinLock`. A request with nested lookups needs hundreds to thousands of paths, so with a few busy cores the threads spin on that lock, and `OperationPlanContext.Clean` returns every array through it once more.

The shared pool now rents and returns arrays in batches of 32, and the request-local pool stays alive in the pooled `FetchResultStore`: after a request it marks its arrays free again and returns only what exceeds `PathSegmentLocalPoolCapacity` (64 by default, 1 the minimum). A request touches the shared lock a few times instead of twice per path. The local pool shrinks its bookkeeping after a burst and drops its arrays when the shared pool has been replaced; the shared pool rejects arrays of another length without unbalancing its in-use count. A result document is detached from the local pool when the store hands its memory to the operation result, so a path read after execution is allocated and never touches another request's arrays. The local pool drops returns once every owned array is free, so a straggling return after a reset cannot hand the same array to two paths, and the shared pool holds its lock for at most 32 arrays per rent or return.

### Benchmarks

Each thread is one pooled request context with its own local pool, running requests back to back. A request rents the given number of paths, returns half and ends. Mean is the time per request on one thread.

#### Path segments, 1 thread, 32 paths per request

| Method | Version | Mean | Ratio | Allocated | Alloc Ratio |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Rent, return, reset | `main` | 588.2 ns | 1.00 | 51 B | 1.00 |
| Rent, return, reset | PR | 145.6 ns | 0.25 | 3 B | 0.06 |

#### Path segments, 1 thread, 1024 paths per request

| Method | Version | Mean | Ratio | Allocated | Alloc Ratio |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Rent, return, reset | `main` | 17.034 µs | 1.00 | 51 B | 1.00 |
| Rent, return, reset | PR | 11.093 µs | 0.65 | 3 B | 0.06 |

#### Path segments, 4 threads, 32 paths per request

| Method | Version | Mean | Ratio | Allocated | Alloc Ratio |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Rent, return, reset | `main` | 11.678 µs | 1.00 | 197 B | 1.00 |
| Rent, return, reset | PR | 0.191 µs | 0.02 | 5 B | 0.03 |

#### Path segments, 4 threads, 1024 paths per request

| Method | Version | Mean | Ratio | Allocated | Alloc Ratio |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Rent, return, reset | `main` | 253.519 µs | 1.00 | 200 B | 1.00 |
| Rent, return, reset | PR | 47.240 µs | 0.19 | 5 B | 0.03 |

#### Path segments, 16 threads, 32 paths per request

| Method | Version | Mean | Ratio | Allocated | Alloc Ratio |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Rent, return, reset | `main` | 29.349 µs | 1.00 | 778 B | 1.00 |
| Rent, return, reset | PR | 1.181 µs | 0.04 | 6 B | 0.01 |
